description: UI layer: new Referral page, admin Settings referral fields, Sidebar nav entry, App route. Depends on FEAT-001 (getReferralStats, generateReferralCode, updateReferralCode helpers) and FEAT-002 (routes must compile). Four files modified, one new file created.
steps: Create src/pages/user/Referral.jsx as a new file. Structure: named export `Referral`. Imports: useState, useEffect from react; useAuth from ../../context/AuthContext; generateReferralCode, updateReferralCode, getReferralStats from ../../lib/db; Share2, Copy, Users, TrendingUp, CheckCircle, Edit3, RefreshCw from lucide-react. State: referralCode (string), editingCode (string), isEditing (bool), stats ({referrals:[], totalEarned:0, activeCount:0}), loading (bool), copying (bool), saving (bool), error (string), success (string). On mount (useEffect), read profile.referral_code: if set, setReferralCode(profile.referral_code); else call generateReferralCode(profile.id) and setReferralCode(result). Then call getReferralStats(profile.id) and setStats. Sections to render: (1) Header card (glass-card with Share2 icon, title 'Referral Program', subtitle 'Earn commission on every daily claim your referred users make'). (2) 'Your Referral Code' glass-card: shows the code in a monospace styled box; an Edit button (Edit3 icon) that toggles isEditing; when editing, an input bound to editingCode + Save button calling updateReferralCode(profile.id, editingCode.toUpperCase()) — on success setReferralCode(newCode) and refreshProfile(); a 'Copy Referral Link' button (Copy icon) that copies `https://nexusgg.vercel.app/signup?ref=${referralCode}` to clipboard using navigator.clipboard.writeText, shows 'Copied!' feedback for 2s; a 'Generate New Code' button (RefreshCw icon) calling generateReferralCode(profile.id). (3) Stats row: 3 glass-card chips — Total Referrals (stats.referrals.length), Commission Earned (₵stats.totalEarned.toFixed(2)), Active Investors (stats.activeCount). (4) Referred Users list glass-card: table/list of stats.referrals showing full_name, masked email (show first 2 chars + '***' + '@' + domain), date joined (created_at formatted), bonus paid badge (green 'Bonus Paid' or grey 'Pending' based on bonus_paid field). If stats.referrals is empty, show empty state 'No referrals yet. Share your link to start earning!' Use the same dark-theme glass-card, text-[#f0f0ff], text-[#8888aa], border-[#2a2a3a], bg-[#00d4ff] accent pattern as existing pages. Error/success messages use red-400/green (00ff88) inline alert pattern from other pages.

Modify src/pages/admin/Settings.jsx: (a) Add GitBranch (or Percent) icon import from lucide-react — use `Percent` icon for commission section header. (b) Extend the form state to include referral_commission_pct: '' and referral_bonus_amount: ''. (c) In the useEffect getSettings() call, also read s.referral_commission_pct and s.referral_bonus_amount into form state (default '10' and '50' if not found). (d) Add a second glass-card section below the MoMo card titled 'Referral Settings' with Percent icon. Inside: a numeric input for 'Commission % (0-100)' bound to form.referral_commission_pct (type='number', min=0, max=100); a numeric input for 'Signup Bonus Amount (₵)' bound to form.referral_bonus_amount (type='number', min=0). (e) In handleSave(), add upsertSetting('referral_commission_pct', String(form.referral_commission_pct)) and upsertSetting('referral_bonus_amount', String(form.referral_bonus_amount)) to the Promise.all array. (f) Add basic validation: commission must be 0-100, bonus must be >= 0 — show setError if not.

Modify src/components/Layout/Sidebar.jsx: (a) Add Share2 to the lucide-react import list. (b) Insert a new entry into the userNav array between Active Investments and Wallet: { to: '/user/referrals', icon: Share2, label: 'Referrals' }.

Modify src/App.jsx: (a) Add import for Referral page: `import { Referral } from './pages/user/Referral';`. (b) Add route inside the user routes block: `<Route path="/user/referrals" element={<ProtectedRoute role="user"><Referral /></ProtectedRoute>} />`.
acceptance_criteria: src/pages/user/Referral.jsx exists and is a valid React component with named export Referral
Admin Settings page has referral commission and bonus fields that save to settings table
Sidebar userNav has Referrals entry between Active Investments and Wallet
App.jsx has /user/referrals route pointing to Referral component
`npm run build` exits 0 with no errors
`npm run lint` produces no new errors
